positions.statement: On his campaign home page, Russ lists ending the IRS 'manhunt' of 1099 employers and employees among his small-business and farm priorities.

positions.statement: On his campaign home page, Russ lists protecting small businesses and family farms as a priority, including stopping subsidies that only benefit large corporations.
On his campaign home page, Russ lists a Minimum Employment Act under his 'Affordability for Working Families' heading.
On his campaign home page, Russ lists returning manufacturing to America under his 'Affordability for Working Families' heading.
